answer: A payout is split thus 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The comet schedule is applied in tide and spiral reveals each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2345 identities would post 1399 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
